title: Senior Design Engineer
must_have: 6+ years of experience in mechanical design
text:
Senior Design Engineer
Ganga Heavy Engineering | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a senior design engineer to join our mechanical design team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- SolidWorks
- Manufacturing Processes
- GD&T
- Finite Element Analysis
- CNC Machining
- 6+ years of experience in mechanical design

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- 3D Printing
- AutoCAD
- Thermodynamics
- PLC Programming

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive heat-exchanger redesign with measurable outcomes.
- Drive fixture development with measurable outcomes.
- Drive gearbox housing redesign with measurable outcomes.
